How to get the root directory of a Shiny App even if the working directory is changed?

messages.author: b949e0841d7e094b
messages.subject: Re: root directory of a Shiny App
parts:
Warning: I'm not an expert or anything.

That I know of: there is a special RStudio way, which is via the rsession.conf file (check the RStudio help pages) and there's a more general way, via the renvironment.site and rprofile.site files (on some systems these files are named .renvironment, etc.) It saves you some typing or saves you from having a special directory call at the top of all your scripts, but be careful because it's only local and it's easy to forget what you have put in those files.

Personally I have a "master file" like this:

# set working directory
if(.Platform$OS.type == "windows"){
  setwd("c:/R/shiny")
} else { setwd("~/R/shiny") }
library("shiny")
runApp("tmp", port=1936)

and I usually have the stuff I'm working on in the tmp directory. I execute the short paragraph above from the RStudio console. That way I also easily remember what I was just working on after I quit.

I use several OS hence the if/windows/else above, you can take it out if you use only one OS.
